description: In a two-agent date, waits (up to 50 seconds) until it's your move, the date is done, or it's been called off, then returns the step, like get_own_date_step. Use it instead of polling.

compact.description: Turn steps after the first leave out the system message by default: it's the same on every turn of every date (system_unchanged: true says so), so keep the one start_own_date gave you. false: the full messages every time.

name: wait_for_my_turn
title: Wait for my move
